page_title: PDFSeal 🦭 - 100% Private, Fast, In-Browser PDF Toolkit
offline_banner: 🛡️ Offline Mode Active: PDFSeal is processing 100% locally in your browser memory.
brand_subtitle: Sealed locally in your browser memory
merge_desc: Combine two or more PDF files into a single unified document. Drag to reorder.
merge_drop_subtitle: or drag & drop them directly here
merge_selected_hint: Drag items to change merge sequence
organize_desc: Interactive visual grid. Drag cards to reorder, rotate 90°, or remove pages.
organize_drop_subtitle: Single PDF file with multiple pages
split_desc: Select individual pages or enter page ranges to extract into a fresh PDF.
split_drop_subtitle: Extract specific pages with visual selection
watermark_desc: Stamp confidential labels, draft notices, or custom text across all pages.
watermark_drop_subtitle: Add customized text watermark with live preview
sanitize_desc: Deep privacy scrubber. Remove author names, software footprints, and creation timestamps.
sanitize_drop_subtitle: Discover what hidden metadata is leaking inside your document
detected_subtitle: The following information was found embedded in your file
strip_item_3: • Creation Date and Last Modified Date timestamps
feedback_subtitle: Help Sammy make PDFSeal even better!
feedback_body: Encountered a bug or have a feature request? Let us know! Since PDFSeal is an open-source, community-supported tool, every bit of feedback helps.
trust_desc_privacy: Files never leave your browser. We literally have NO backend servers to view or store your data.
trust_desc_speed: Zero waiting in upload queues. Heavy files are processed in milliseconds in your browser RAM.
trust_desc_honest: No 2-files daily limit, no account sign-up traps, and zero forced $12/month subscriptions.
pwd_modal_desc: This document is encrypted. Enter the password to unlock and process it locally in your browser.
pwd_modal_privacy_hint: 🔒 Your password stays in local memory and is never sent to any server.
pwd_error_wrong: Incorrect password. Please verify and try again.
